column3: [Security] Get the reactor complex open so we can get down to safety.
[Security] I'm telling you... ugh... you have to get to the generator... ugh...

[Security] Hey, it's no good up there, everything's sealed off tight. The only way out is to find someone with scanner access who can open the front door. I'm pretty sure there's a few scientists hiding somewhere in the labs. Maybe if we team up, we can track 'em down and get 'em to let us out.
[Security] All this is happening because of you scientists!
[Security] That's right, you're the ones who created these mutants!
[Security] Freeman, right? I've got a message for you. Make sure you don't... Aaaagh!
[Security] What the hell is that thing?!
[Security] Hey, what the hell are you doing down here? Get topside! I heard troops are coming in to save us!
[Security] Come on, Gordon, you trying to get me into trouble?
[Security] Elevators are out of order, but we can still climb.
[Security] Hey, better let me check those wounds.
[Security] That's a real bad wound, fella.

[Security] Hey, Mr. Freeman. I had a bunch of messages for you, but we had a system crash about twenty minutes ago and I'm still trying to find my files. Just one of those days, I guess. They were having some problems down in the test chamber too, but I think that's all straightened out. They told me to make sure you headed down there as soon as you got into your hazard suit.
[Security] Gordon! Man, am I glad to see you! What the hell are these things? And why are they wearing science team uniforms?
[Security] Wrong airlock, Mr. Freeman. You know I can't let you through here.
[Security] Help me... Help me... Somebody please help me, I'm... I'm dying here... Please help me...
[Security] Sorry, Mr. Freeman, I've got strict orders not to let you through without your hazard suit.
[Security] Go right on through, sir. Looks like you're in for it today.

[Security] Mister, if you can get the power back on, this train'll take us straight to the surface. I'd try it myself, but it's a long way down to the generator room, and there's... things in the way.
[Security] I... I'm not gonna make it. You'd better go on without me.
[Security] I could sure go for a cold one right about now.
[Security] I'd sure like to know the guy responsible for this.
[Security] Should make for good target practice.
[Security] I got a bad feeling about this.
[Security] Sure hope we don't walk into an ambush.
[Security] Morning, Mr. Freeman. Looks like you're running late.

[Security] Freeman, I've been waiting for you. One of your scientist buddies asked me to give you a message. You're supposed to take this old rail system up to some kind of satellite rocket. I don't know where it is, and the old man was so scared he wouldn't make it out alive that he didn't tell me. The main thing is, the military aborted the launch, so when you find the rocket, you'll have to get up to the control room and launch it yourself. He said something about the Lambda team needing that satellite in orbit if they're ever gonna clean up this mess.
[Security] Hey! Heey! Hey, let me out of here!
[Security] I'll turn the lights on and you can try again.
[Security] Man, and I thought I'd had a long night — you look awful. I don't think the day's gonna get any easier, either. Look, I'll wait right here, and you... you go on ahead if you need to.
[Security] Sorry, sir... I can't hold out any longer.
[Security] Let's team up, we'll have a better chance together.
[Security] We'll do a lot better together.
[Security] Sorry, I can't leave my post.
[Security] I'll stay down here. If I see anything that doesn't belong, I'll start shooting.
[Security] If I were topside right now, I'd sure love to knock back a cold one.
[Security] You wouldn't happen to know the way out of here, would you?
[Security] What are you thinking about right now?
[Security] Just hope I don't lose a leg to these things.
[Security] Think it can get any worse?
[Security] Sure glad I've got my .38 on me today.
[Security] What were you guys working on in there, anyway?
[Security] What the hell is going on here?
[Security] I don't know about you, but I'm not scared.
[Security] They sure didn't cover this in our drills.
[Security] I think we're getting closer to the exit.
[Security] Today's your lucky day. There's an RPG inside — laser-guided and everything. If you can figure out how to get in there, you'll be able to fight these bastards on even terms.
[Security] Whoa there, watch it with that!
[Security] What did I ever do to you?!
[Security] They say as soon as we get topside, the military's gonna take care of us.
[Security] Smells like something died in here.
[Security] I'm hit! Keep your head down! A sniper got me!
[Security] Hey, don't count on the cavalry finding us down here. Head for the surface!
[Security] So this is the guy? We thought you'd never make it!
[Security] Yeah, you'd better finish that thing off.
[Security] Enough to know that if you don't destroy it, there won't be much left to come back to.
[Security] Don't forget to gear up. I'll cover you while you wait for that portal to warm up.
[Security] What is that thing? Some kind of weapon?
[Security] Man, why aren't we using it?

[Hologram] The next three jumps get harder each time, but they are quite possible. Don't be surprised if you miss the last one once or twice. If you can make all three in one continuous run, you are doing great.
[Hologram] Finally, if nothing else works, try breaking the obstructions in your path. Make sure you pick up the crowbar, and simply smash your way through the debris.

[Hologram] Swim up to the surface and catch your breath. You will see the oxygen indicator on your suit display return to its previous level. Once it does, you can swim through the rest of the section.
[Hologram] If you see one of these buttons, press it and I will appear to demonstrate certain moves.

[Hologram] This is a charging unit for your HEV hazardous environment suit. When your power is running low, step up to any charger and press your Use key. Your suit will recharge gradually until the charger unit is depleted. Individual batteries may also be used to recharge your HEV suit.
[Hologram] Congratulations. You have completed the Black Mesa target range. Please advance to the next area.
[Hologram] Congratulations on completing the Black Mesa Hazard Course. You are now fully certified for use of the HEV Mark IV protective system.

[Hologram] Your HEV suit monitors blood oxygen levels, warning you when you need to find an air supply. As you swim through this course, your oxygen levels will begin to drop. At the midpoint, you will be given an opportunity to surface for air.
[Hologram] Now duck under the next set of obstacles. Please note that crouching automatically shifts your suit into stealth mode, minimizing movement noise.
[Hologram] If you keep falling short, you may be jumping too soon.
[Hologram] Activate your suit flashlight for the next area.
[Hologram] Great work! Now there's just one more style of jumping you need to learn.
[Hologram] To fire the grenade launcher, use your alternate fire button. Certain targets will break only when hit by grenades.

[Hologram] To pass this test, you must hit every target. If you miss the first time, don't worry, they will come around again. Try to reload during pauses rather than waiting to run out of ammunition at a critical time.
[Hologram] Please advance to the next area.

[Hologram] Hello and welcome to the Black Mesa Hazard Course, where you'll be trained in the use of a hazardous environment suit. I am your holographic assistant. Let's begin by stepping into your suit. You can see it suspended up ahead of you.
[Hologram] Now we will combine skills. You will need to jump, duck, and then jump again. This will prepare you for the next room, where you will have to do both moves at the same time.

[Hologram] The first move we'll practice in the Hazard Course is basic jumping. You'll attempt to get over this set of pipes using only your run and jump commands. It helps to get a running start. Watch me, and then try it yourself.

[Hologram] Now that you're up here, there's only one way down. Find the target on the floor below and do your best to hit it. If you take any damage from the fall, we will administer medical care at the next station.
[Hologram] Sometimes you'll need to rely on more than just your suit to get through a tight place. Try jumping this gap on your own.
[Hologram] Walk directly into the ladder, look up, and continue moving forward. If you want to come back down, just move backward.

[Hologram] Lead a security guard into the next room. He will let you back into the transit system. You must approach a guard and press your Use key. He will follow your lead until you face him and press the Use key again.
[Hologram] Great. Remember your flashlight drains power, so switch it off when you don't need it.

[Hologram] Long-jumping requires its own charging module, seen here. To activate your long jump, you will have to duck and move forward, and then launch into a jump. Once you're up on the platform, press the button and I will demonstrate the move.

[Hologram] You'll find medkits like this one throughout the Black Mesa facility. To restore your health, walk up to a medkit and press your Use key. Your health will recover gradually until you are at full health or the kit is depleted. Once the light goes out, a medkit cannot be reused.

[Hologram] Moving around in your HEV suit may be slightly disorienting at first. Take a moment to familiarize yourself with basic movement, and soon it will fit you like a second skin. I'll see you around the corner.

[Hologram] To get into these pipes, you'll have to signal your suit to make a duck-jump. You'll want to stand right at the mouth of the pipe, and continue to press forward. Then jump up, and while you're in mid-air, go into a crouch. It's tricky, but you'll find it comes in handy.

[Hologram] If you can't push an obstacle out of the way, you might try pulling it. To pull a box, move up to it and press your Use key. While holding down the Use key to keep a grip on the box, move slowly backward. The box will come along with you.
[Hologram] What you really need to do is push that box down into the pit. Pushing is easy. Just move forward against the box, and you can push it into position.
[Hologram] Proximity to radiation activates a Geiger counter and radiation display. Biohazards are also indicated with a luminous icon.
[Hologram] Try again. Remember to move forward, jump, and crouch while in mid-air.
